topic: Troubleshooting data drop from Lithuanian box
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a specific advertising box in Lithuania (JCD_LT_VIL0007DD) that was reportedly not sending data since early June. Initial checks by [me] indicated the unit was stable, pingable, and transmitting data normally.

[p1] suggested checking if the facility ID or asset ID was incorrect. [me] confirmed these were correctly configured. The conversation shifted to signal strength (signal limit in calibration vs. actual reading) and whether the location was a mall or not. 

Ultimately, [p1] reported that data *was* present but had sharply dropped off. It was concluded that while initial checks should be performed by [me], investigating the surrounding environment/inventory was also necessary, suggesting the issue might be external to simple calibration or model issues.
decisions: The immediate cause of the data drop requires investigation beyond standard system checks.
action_items: [p1] will visit the location the next day to investigate the issue on-site.
